steps.note: The cheese is dissolved into a smooth emulsion with water and calcium-sequestering salts.
How hot and how long depends on the cheese, its age and the recipe.
The slurry is brought to 35-45 % total solids before it is dried.
Spray drying turns the slurry into a powder, at the cost of some aroma.

links.name: A Review on the Production and Characteristics of Cheese Powders (Foods 13, 2204)

sources.text: That the cheese is made into an emulsion with water and calcium-sequestering (emulsifying) salts, concentrated to 35-45 % solids, homogenised and spray dried, from these; the review abstract gives no temperatures, so none are given here.
